title: Which one is better?
author: ishitonyouu
selftext:
So I connected chatgpt to my charts through a tunnel and gave it a few restrictions. It’s actually doing a pretty good job identifying zones, but it tends to switch bias as soon as it sees shifts in delta.  
I’m planning on connecting it to deepcharts too, but I’m not sure if I should stick with chatgpt or try claude instead. What do you think?

Also is it possible to connect it to deepcharts ? 

Im using topstepx I’m using their L1 and L2 data, but it still doesn’t feel like enough.
